_comment: SAM INCUS CLOUD remote Incus container lifecycle egg. Requires restricted Incus TLS client credentials.
name: SAM Incus VPS
author: SAM INCUS CLOUD
description: Creates and starts one remote Incus container per Pterodactyl server using the Incus HTTPS API.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
cd /mnt/server
python3 -m pip install --no-cache-dir requests
if [ ! -f incus_egg.py ]; then echo 'Upload incus_egg.py to the server root before installation.'; exit 1; fi
chmod 755 incus_egg.py
echo 'SAM Incus egg installed.'

variables.name: Incus API URL
variables.description: Private HTTPS API URL reachable from Wings, e.g. https://10.0.0.5:8443

variables.name: Incus Project
variables.description: Dedicated Incus project for managed VPS instances.

variables.name: Client certificate path
variables.description: Path to Incus TLS client certificate uploaded to this server.

variables.name: Client private key path
variables.description: Matching TLS private key. Never expose this file or variable to customers.

variables.name: Server CA path
variables.description: Optional CA certificate file used to verify the Incus API server certificate.

variables.name: TLS verification
variables.description: Keep true in production; use a trusted CA instead of disabling verification.

variables.name: Instance name override
variables.description: Leave blank to derive a unique name from the Pterodactyl server UUID.

variables.name: Incus image
variables.description: Image alias available to Incus, e.g. images:debian/13 or images:ubuntu/24.04.

variables.name: RAM limit
variables.description: Actual Incus RAM limit, e.g. 4GiB. Set by admin according to plan.

variables.name: Disk limit
variables.description: Actual Incus root disk size, e.g. 25GiB.

variables.name: Enable nesting
variables.description: Enable only if required and approved by the administrator.
